purpose: Extract the earliest recorded failure under a complete comparable chronology or explicit input-order assertion.
trigger: Use when a run has failed/stopped and logs, events, and state are available.

inputs.name: events
inputs.description: Failure records, optionally wrapped in events/stage_events/error_logs.

inputs.name: run_ref
inputs.description: Optional current run; reject mixed explicit event run references.

inputs.name: ordered
inputs.description: False default; true asserts that input order is authoritative when timestamps/sequence are incomplete.

preconditions: Caller must establish run association when records lack run_ref; this helper does not infer missing identity or physical causality. It returns recorded chronology, not a root-cause diagnosis.
Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

outputs.name: run_ref
outputs.description: Present when supplied or resolved from records.

postconditions: Extract the earliest recorded failure under a complete comparable chronology or explicit input-order assertion.
Only the declared flat result fields are returned; no desktop or unperformed persistence layer is implied.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host tooling; no SpaceClaim control or geometry mutation is implied.
implementation.notes: Call capture_earliest_failure_state(**payload), or dispatch("EX-12", payload). Rejected inputs raise HostActionError (with code); filesystem failures may propagate OSError. Caller must establish run association when records lack run_ref; this helper does not infer missing identity or physical causality. It returns recorded chronology, not a root-cause diagnosis. The linked guide uses conceptual fields; explicitly adapt them to this canonical function interface, never dispatch the guide output directly.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.

semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve raw logs and choose no repair target.

failure_modes.condition: Records from different runs are being combined.
failure_modes.detection: run_ref values differ or cannot be joined uniquely.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and request missing context.
Partition by one run_ref or return needs_manual_review; never merge.
